# Ashish Ghimire

> Homelab, self-hosting and cybersecurity write-ups: hands-on guides for Proxmox, Docker, Linux, networking and Windows, from a lab that actually runs.

This is the personal engineering blog of Ashish Ghimire, an IT graduate
based in Sydney, Australia. Every post is a first-hand write-up of something
built, broken or fixed in a real home lab: Proxmox and Docker infrastructure, OPNsense
and VLAN networking, self-hosted services, Linux and Windows administration, and
offensive-security walkthroughs. Posts include the failures and dead ends, not just the
happy path.

Author: [Ashish Ghimire](https://ashishghimire.com/about/).
Contact: https://ashishghimire.com, https://github.com/ghimireaacs, https://www.youtube.com/@ashishghimire, https://tryhackme.com/p/ghostaacs, https://linktr.ee/aacsghimire
License: content is the author's own; cite with a link to the post URL.

Commands and configurations reflect the software and setup described in each dated article.





## Homelab


- [OPNsense Logging to Grafana via Loki: Three Gotchas That Will Catch You](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/opnsense-logging-loki-grafana/): Three silent failures in my OPNsense logging pipeline, from syslog-ng through Promtail to Loki and Grafana, and how I diagnosed them. Category: Homelab > Networking. Published 2026-04-21, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: opnsense, grafana, loki, promtail, syslog-ng, kubernetes, selfhosted, observability, filterlog.



- [My Electricity Bill Jumped From $300 to $800 in One Quarter. My Homelab Did It.](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/homelab-electricity-bill-ram-fix/): My electricity bill rose from $300 to $800 after expanding the homelab. How I investigated RAM pressure, local AI, and unused workloads. Category: Homelab > Self-Hosting. Published 2026-04-11, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: proxmox, kubernetes, homelab, electricity, ram, cost, selfhosted, ollama, ai.



- [I Finally Know If Anyone Reads This Blog](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/blog-analytics-umami/): How I set up self-hosted Umami analytics on an Oracle VM and connected it to my Jekyll blog to see page views and referrers without cookies. Category: Homelab > Self-Hosting. Published 2026-03-21, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: umami, analytics, selfhosted, cloudflare, jekyll, oracle.



- [Syncthing Three-Way Sync Across VLANs](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/Syncthing-Three-Way-Sync-Across-VLANs/): How I fixed Syncthing across VLANs with discovery and relays disabled, using static device addresses to sync files between three devices. Category: Homelab > Networking. Published 2026-03-20, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: syncthing, vlan, networking, opnsense, docker, selfhosted.



- [Broken Docker DNS Due to Pi-hole](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/Broken-Docker-DNS-Due-to-PiHole/): Docker DNS kept failing despite correct daemon settings. I traced it to leftover Pi-hole nftables rules redirecting DNS traffic to a closed port. Category: Homelab > Networking. Published 2026-03-11, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: docker, dns, pihole, networking, debugging.



- [How I Utilize Github to Store and Download My Public SSH Keys](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/How-I-Utilize-Github-For-SSH/): How I store public SSH keys on GitHub and import them onto new Linux servers with ssh-import-id, without copying keys by hand. Category: Homelab > Self-Hosting. Published 2025-08-09, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: ssh, linux, github, homelab, security, keygen, ed25519.



- [Installing Proxmox and Post Installation](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/Install-Proxmox-And-Post-Installation/): Turn an old PC into a Proxmox VE server. Prepare a bootable USB, install the hypervisor, and complete the initial configuration. Category: Homelab > Self-Hosting. Published 2025-07-23, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: proxmox, linux, homelab, virtualization, selfhosted, hypervisor.



- [Installing Docker and Setting Permission](https://ashishghimire.com/posts/Install-Docker-And-Manage-Permission/): Install Docker from its official apt repository and configure docker group permissions. Understand why running Docker without sudo grants root access. Category: Homelab > Self-Hosting. Published 2025-07-06, updated 2026-10-20. Tags: docker, linux, ubuntu, containers, homelab, permissions.
